title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Secretversary 2021
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Universes Beyond Secret Lair drops)

paragraphs.text: Secretversary 2021 is a series of drops in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It was available for pre-order purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com from November 29th through December 23rd, 2021.

Secretversary 2021 is a superdrop to celebrate the two-year anniversary of the Secret Lair Drop Series. Part of the superdrop is a two-part collaboration with Riot Games to advertise Arcane , the 2021 Netflix series based on the multiplayer online battle arena video game League of Legends . These cards feature screenshots of the show as the card art, and remarkably no legendary creatures. Two other drops are Dracula themed, expanding on the Crimson Vow Dracula Series .

The drops can be bought separately or in one of four bundles. The Non-Foil Second Secretversary Bundle for $199.99 includes one copy of each drop available in non-foil (all of them except Heads I Win, Tails You Lose ). The Foil Second Secretversary Bundle for $299.99 includes one copy of each drop available in foil and foil-etched (except Heads I Win, Tails You Lose ). The Bundle Bundle for $479.99 combines the previous two bundles. The Bundled Bundle Bundle for $549.99 includes the Heads I Win, Tails You Lose Commander decks .
The PixelSnowLands drop features recycled test print sheets ("make ready sheets") as part of the packaging of the cards.
As an extra, each drop comes with a surprise bonus card.
